permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Reads your phone's approximate location once every 30 minutes so the weather card shows the forecast where you are. Used only to build the open-meteo request; never stored or sent anywhere else. If declined, the weather falls back to the configured home coordinates.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Fetches Duck Ops dashboard data from widget_api (8780) and phils-bridge (8790) on the Mac mini, reachable via Tailscale (works on Wi-Fi + cellular). LAN entries kept for fallback. Plus open-meteo weather and ESPN sports public APIs.
